subject.title: fix(linux): draw the macOS tray icon from a template silhouette

question: Should this visual macOS fix wait for the separately tracked macOS private-API build path to be made landable, or may it land now with attached evidence that clearly states the prerequisite configuration?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the available real-world result was produced with deliberately omitted local changes, so only maintainers can decide whether that prerequisite is acceptable for this independent fix.

options.title: Require landable macOS proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted capture or diagnostic artifact shows the final branch running through a supported macOS build path.

options.title: Land as an isolated asset correction
options.body: Accept the separately tracked macOS build prerequisite and land only after maintainers confirm the attached evidence adequately isolates the icon behavior.

recommendation.title: Require landable macOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted capture or diagnostic artifact shows the final branch running through a supported macOS build path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged companion history and the PR’s explicit analysis connect steipete most directly to both the changed tray path and the stated prerequisite.
